scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Name of the global scope for this application (organizational tenant)

cluster.title: Cluster
cluster.description: Name of the cluster running this application (platform tenant)

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Name of the environment for this application (ex: dev, factory, preprod or prod)

component.title: Component
component.description: Component name of this application (logical tenant)

app.title: App
app.description: Application name (functional tenant, default use Chart name)

version.title: Version
version.description: Version name of this application (default use Chart appVersion)

flowcollector.title: Flowcollector
flowcollector.description: Deploy the FlowCollector CR driving the Network Observability operator (eBPF agents, flow processor, console plugin)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the FlowCollector CR (cluster-scoped, a single FlowCollector is allowed per cluster)

hooked.title: Hooked
hooked.description: Activate the resource as a helm hook

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the FlowCollector (must be "cluster" for the operator to reconcile it)

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Namespace where the operator deploys the netobserv components (flow processor, console plugin). The operator creates it when it does not exist and runs the eBPF agents in the <namespace>-privileged namespace. Immutable once created

deploymentModel.title: Deployment Model
deploymentModel.description: Flow processing deployment model. Service (operator default) runs the processor behind a Service backed by a scalable Deployment, Direct pairs a processor DaemonSet with the agents through the host network (small clusters below 15 nodes only), Kafka sends the flows to a Kafka topic consumed by the processor (large clusters, see the kafka block)

infra_enabled.title: Infra enabled
infra_enabled.description: Place the flow processor and the console plugin on the infra nodes (nodeSelector and tolerations). The eBPF agents are never constrained (the DaemonSet must run on every node and tolerates every taint by default) and the processor is not constrained either when deploymentModel is Direct (it then runs as a DaemonSet paired with the agents)

networkPolicy.title: Network Policy
networkPolicy.description: Network policies protecting the netobserv namespaces (spec.networkPolicy)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Deploy the network policies isolating the netobserv components (enabled by default by the operator on OVN-Kubernetes)

additionalNamespaces.title: Additional Namespaces
additionalNamespaces.description: Additional namespaces allowed to connect to the netobserv namespace (raw list of namespace names)

sampling.title: Sampling
sampling.description: Sampling interval of the eBPF probe (50 means one packet out of 50 is sampled, 0 or 1 means all packets are sampled)

privileged.title: Privileged
privileged.description: Run the eBPF agent pods as privileged. Required by the PacketDrop, NetworkEvents and UDNMapping features and to capture SR-IOV secondary interfaces, otherwise the agent only gets the BPF, PERFMON and NET_ADMIN capabilities

features.title: Features
features.description: Additional eBPF features to enable among PacketDrop (privileged), DNSTracking, FlowRTT, NetworkEvents (privileged, OVN-Kubernetes observability), PacketTranslation, EbpfManager (requires the eBPF Manager operator), UDNMapping (privileged), IPSec and TLSTracking. Every feature increases the CPU, memory and storage footprint

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Compute resources of the eBPF agent container (raw map, empty keeps the operator default of 800Mi memory limit)

processor.title: Processor
processor.description: Configuration of the flow processor flowlogs-pipeline (spec.processor)

logTypes.title: Log Types
logTypes.description: Record types to generate: Flows (regular flows), Conversations, EndedConversations or All

consumerReplicas.title: Consumer Replicas
consumerReplicas.description: Number of processor replicas in the Service and Kafka deployment models (0 keeps the operator default of 3, ignored in the Direct deployment model)

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Prometheus metrics generated by the processor (spec.processor.metrics)

includeList.title: Include List
includeList.description: Metrics to generate, named without the netobserv_ prefix (raw list, empty keeps the operator default list)

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Compute resources of the processor container (raw map, empty keeps the operator default of 800Mi memory limit)

loki.title: Loki
loki.description: Storage of the raw flows in Loki (spec.loki)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Store the flows in Loki. When disabled only the Prometheus metrics are kept and the console plugin loses the raw flows table and the per-pod details

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Loki installation mode: LokiStack (Loki operator), Monolithic, Microservices or Manual (see extraSpec for their URLs)

lokiStack.title: Loki Stack
lokiStack.description: Reference of the LokiStack CR used by the LokiStack mode. Deploy it with the cluster-loki chart using tenants.mode openshift-network (a LokiStack must not be shared with the OpenShift Logging stack)

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Namespace of the LokiStack CR (default is the flowcollector namespace, see lokiRbac when it differs)

extraSpec.title: Extra Spec
extraSpec.description: Additional spec.loki fields appended as is (raw map): monolithic, microservices or manual URLs, timeouts, batch sizes

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Deploy the Network Traffic console plugin (requires Loki or the Prometheus metrics)

quickFilters.title: Quick Filters
quickFilters.description: Quick filter presets displayed in the console plugin (raw list of name, filter and default, empty keeps the operator defaults)

kafka.title: Kafka
kafka.description: Kafka connection used when deploymentModel is Kafka (raw map rendered as spec.kafka: address, topic, tls, sasl). The Kafka cluster and the topic must exist (deploy them with the cluster-kafka chart)

exporters.title: Exporters
exporters.description: Exporters receiving a copy of the enriched flows (raw list rendered as spec.exporters: Kafka, IPFIX or OpenTelemetry)

extraSpec.title: Extra Spec
extraSpec.description: Additional FlowCollector spec fields appended as is at the end of the spec (raw map). Never repeat a field managed by the values above (namespace, deploymentModel, networkPolicy, agent, processor, loki, consolePlugin, kafka, exporters)

flowMetrics.title: Flow Metrics
flowMetrics.description: Deploy FlowMetric CRs generating custom Prometheus metrics from the flow fields

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the FlowMetric CRs

hooked.title: Hooked
hooked.description: Activate the resources as helm hooks

list.title: List
list.description: List of the FlowMetric CRs to create (they must live in the flowcollector namespace to be picked up by the processor)

lokiRbac.title: Loki Rbac
lokiRbac.description: RoleBindings letting the operator read the LokiStack certificates when the LokiStack lives in another namespace than the flowcollector namespace (secret-watcher in the LokiStack namespace, secret-creator in the flowcollector namespace). Not needed when both share the same namespace. The flowcollector namespace must exist (the operator creates it once the FlowCollector is reconciled, so with Helm enable this block on a second upgrade)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable the creation of the RoleBindings

operatorNamespace.title: Operator Namespace
operatorNamespace.description: Namespace hosting the Network Observability operator (operator.subscription.namespace)

serviceAccount.title: Service Account
serviceAccount.description: Service account of the operator controller manager
